title: Subscriber Cross Site Scripting (XSS) in Podamibe Custom User Gravatar <= 1.0.8 versions. (CVE-2026-54865)
description: A Cross Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Podamibe Custom User Gravatar versions up to and including 1.0.8. This vulnerability affects subscribers and allows for execution of malicious scripts in the context of the affected application.
